text:
Maya: Tiny poll: whats your most embarrassing but beloved guilty-pleasure soundtrack? Mines the ‘90s teen rom-com vibe. Asking for a nostalgic commute.
Owen: Ooh easy  the Clueless soundtrack. Absolute bops and zero shame.
Tess: Ill put my hand up for the Legally Blonde OST  it makes me feel like wearing pink and solving puzzles.
Harpreet: Notorious guilty-pleasure: the Twilight soundtrack. Sneaky acoustic bits that hit at 2am. :ghost:
jukebox-bot: Adding user picks to public microplaylist: https://open.spotify.com/playlist/guilty-commute-2487 (curated by jukebox-bot)
Maya: Love these. Any single track recs from those OSTs that are discreet-phone friendly? I dont want to broadcast my inner rom-com.
Owen: Single-track stealth: 'Kissing You' (Des'ree) from Romeo + Juliet  quiet and dramatic.
Tess: 'Perfect Day' (Lou Reed) always sneaks into the vibe list  low key and oddly tender.
Harpreet: If you want instrumental-ish: the Twilight score has a lot of soft piano interludes  search 'Twilight score piano' for low-profile picks.
Maya: Also looking for a one-sentence lunchtime read rec. Something tiny but delightful.
Owen: 'The Lover's Dictionary'  bite-sized entries, perfect for eating lunch and smiling awkwardly.
Tess: 'The House on Mango Street'  short vignettes that you can finish between courses.
Harpreet: ops-bot: reminder  free lunch in the kitchen at 12:30 today for team catch-up.
Maya: Great thread. Will assemble playlist and bring a couple of paperbacks tomorrow. Guilty pleasures never felt so communal. :headphones: :sandwich:
